description: VN 'đề cập về' transfer: learners calque 'về'=about onto the transitive verb mention ('mention about the plan'). Rule en-vietlish-mention-about drops 'about' (mirrors en-step6-discuss-about / en-vietlish-research-about) ONLY when 'mention' is a VERB. A negative lookbehind blocks determiners/quantifiers/possessives and 'make ... mention' so the NOUN sense ('a/no/the mention about', 'made mention about') is left untouched.
fp_risk_note: Low-medium risk. 'about' is correct after the NOUN 'mention' and after other verbs (talk/think about). V1 fires only when 'about' immediately follows a finite form of the VERB 'mention'; the lookbehind locks out the noun sense. Negatives: a different verb, the noun sense with a determiner, a no-'about' sentence, and a non-mention 'about' phrase.

positive.input: I want to mention about the plan.
positive.expectedCorrection: I want to mention the plan.

positive.input: They are mentioning about the problem.

negative.notes: Different verb 'talk' (about is correct) -> must not fire.

negative.input: There was no mention about it.
negative.expectedCorrection: There was no mention about it.
negative.notes: Noun 'mention' (lookbehind 'no') -> 'about' is correct, must abstain. (Precision lock.)

negative.input: She made a brief mention about it.
negative.expectedCorrection: She made a brief mention about it.

negative.input: He mentioned that he was late.
negative.expectedCorrection: He mentioned that he was late.
negative.notes: No 'about' after the verb -> must not fire.

negative.input: This is a movie about war.
negative.expectedCorrection: This is a movie about war.
negative.notes: No mention verb at all -> must not fire.
